result.description:
No keys or verifiers leave storage. Version includes retired/current key
identities internally so a regrant cannot revive a stale revocation request.

placements.description: Whole variants after a move; legacy documents and receipts omit these.

contents.description:
Current members, including earlier trash and conflicts, for scope preview.
None means unsupported contents; legacy receipts also omit this field.

empty.description: True only when there are no cards or unknown contents.

positions.description: All distinct position registers; conflicting values are never overwritten.

spaces.description: Only spaces containing matches, in the same order as space.list.

empty.description: This slice only trashes/restores spaces without domain content.

names.description: All distinct current names; multiple names require conflict resolution.

version.description: Includes causal assignment history, so deletion cannot expand silently.

ErrorCode.description:
Shared machine-readable errors, without credentials, SQL or platform details.

Codes describe semantics, not HTTP statuses or retry policy. A stale request
requires a fresh read and a new explicit action. An unknown outcome requires
checking/replaying the original command, never inventing a new command ID.

IpcInvocation.description:
Tauri framing preserves the original JSON string, including duplicate
fields for the concrete decoder to reject. Credentials are a separate IPC
argument, never part of the command or a saved client intention.

before.description: Insert before this active card in the destination; null appends.
Insert before this active column; null appends.

Rank.description: Legacy integer positions remain valid in historical documents and receipts.

scope.description: Hosts map the active space to Space; clearing query never changes scope.

placement_conflict.description: These hits precede ordinary board positions inside their space.

spaces.description: Only spaces containing matches, in the same order as space.list.

space.description: All current names; len > 1 identifies the leading name-conflict group.
